The NASAQ Engineering Standard

Why Abu Dhabi homeowners choose NASAQ
over conventional contractors.

Too many clients in Abu Dhabi endure broken promises—months of contractor delays, impossible 3D designs that fail on-site, cheap material substitutions, and dangerous ceiling work. NASAQ was built around 6 non-negotiable engineering standards.

Guarantee 01

Structural Heavy-Load Backing

We never mount heavy crystal chandeliers or blackout curtains directly to weak drywall. NASAQ installs heavy-gauge structural steel unistrut brackets bolted directly into the concrete slab—tested to support up to 150 kg with zero ceiling cracking.

✓ Anti-Collapse Safety
Guarantee 02

100% Reality-Engineered Execution

No fantasy Pinterest pictures that fail on-site. Every project begins with 3D laser millimeter surveying and 2D CAD shop drawings, ensuring exact dimensions, wall reveals, and electrical conduit alignments before cutting a single board.

✓ Exact 3D-to-Reality Match
Guarantee 03

Strict Milestone Timeline SLA

No 6-month delays. We operate on contractually binding milestones—72 hours for living rooms, 10 to 14 days for receptions. Clients receive weekly WhatsApp video walkthroughs and photo logs tracking progress against milestones.

✓ Zero Stalling Guarantee
Guarantee 04

Material Authenticity Sign-Off

Zero material bait-and-switch. We bring physical sample boards (certified ASTM C1396 gypsum, Jotun Fenomastic silk paints, high-density polyurethane mouldings) to your property for your physical signature before installation begins.

✓ 100% Certified Materials
Guarantee 05

Every Project Gets VIP Engineering

We never ignore or dismiss focused scopes. Whether you need a 72-hour living room feature wall in Saadiyat or an entire 12-bedroom villa in Al Bateen, you receive senior engineering management, site hygiene, and responsive daily communication.

✓ Dedicated Senior Oversight
Guarantee 06

Transparent BOQ & Fixed Pricing

Clear, itemized, trade-by-trade Bill of Quantities. All work permits, logistics, and surface protection are included upfront so you never face hidden invoices or unexpected mid-project charges.

✓ Zero Hidden Charges

Frequently Asked Questions

Direct answers from our engineering team.

Clear information on our fit-out processes, contractor certifications, BOQ transparency, and standards across Abu Dhabi and the UAE.

What is the best certified interior design & fit-out company in Abu Dhabi?

NASAQ Interior Design Implementation Works LLC is recognized as a leading certified interior contractor in Abu Dhabi. NASAQ holds official DED licensing, operates under TAMM municipal permitting, and coordinates directly with Abu Dhabi Civil Defence (ADCD), backed by 11+ continuous years of hands-on UAE site craftsmanship for luxury villas, commercial spaces, and executive offices.

Can I get a free interior design consultation or BOQ review in Abu Dhabi?

Yes. NASAQ provides complimentary preliminary architectural blueprint reviews and free initial BOQ (Bill of Quantities) budget estimations for villa and commercial property owners across Abu Dhabi and Dubai, helping evaluate project feasibility and municipal compliance before construction.

Why should property owners avoid "cheap" interior fit-out quotes in the UAE?

Extremely low-cost fit-out bids usually disguise critical omissions: sub-standard light-gauge metal framing prone to sagging, unrated gypsum in wet areas, omission of TAMM municipal approval fees, and non-compliant MEP works that fail Civil Defence inspection. Certified contractors like NASAQ guarantee long-term durability and full code compliance.

What interior fit-out services does NASAQ provide in Abu Dhabi?

NASAQ provides complete turnkey interior fit-out and decoration execution: decorative gypsum ceilings, feature walls, acoustic partitions, custom woodwork, Level-5 architectural painting, and complete villa and office renovations.
